top_band: upper crown of palm fronds (light/mid green, rows 1-10) curving over the trunk
evidence: Palm tree shown in 3/4 view: the top of the frond crown is visible from above (rows 1-10, highlighted in bright green at row 5) overhanging the segmented brown trunk (rows 11-40) with shadow cast onto the upper trunk.

style.evidence: The candidate uses a 5-step green ramp and 5-step brown ramp with dark green and dark brown outlines. However, compared to the Beodeul reference trees, the palm fronds are drawn as smooth, continuous linear strips and the trunk has mechanical horizontal bands and a flat cut-off base (row 40) rather than organic roots and rich leaf cluster texture, making it look stiffer and slightly sticker-like.
